mapper.select: SELECT TENANT_KEY,SOURCE_KEY,CONFIG_HASH,CURSOR_VALUE,PENDING_JSON,ERROR_CODE,JOB_ID,REVISION,LEASE_OWNER,LEASE_UNTIL,NEXT_POLL_AT,PAUSED,CONTROL_REVISION,LAST_SUCCESS_AT,ACTIVE_RUN_ID FROM KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND DELETED=0
mapper.update: UPDATE KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC SET CURSOR_VALUE=#{row.cursorValue},PENDING_JSON=#{row.pendingJson},ERROR_CODE=#{row.errorCode}, JOB_ID=#{row.jobId},LEASE_OWNER=#{row.leaseOwner},LEASE_UNTIL=#{row.leaseUntil},NEXT_POLL_AT=#{row.nextPollAt},LAST_SUCCESS_AT=#{row.lastSuccessAt},ACTIVE_RUN_ID=#{row.activeRunId},REVISION=REVISION+1 WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{row.tenantKey} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{row.sourceKey} AND REVISION=#{expected} AND LEASE_OWNER=#{owner} AND LEASE_UNTIL > #{now} AND DELETED=0
UPDATE KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC SET PENDING_JSON=NULL WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{row.tenantKey} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{row.sourceKey} AND REVISION=#{row.revision} AND ACTIVE_RUN_ID IS NULL AND DELETED=0
mapper.select: SELECT TENANT_KEY,SOURCE_KEY,CONFIG_HASH,CURSOR_VALUE,PENDING_JSON,ERROR_CODE,JOB_ID,REVISION,LEASE_OWNER,LEASE_UNTIL,NEXT_POLL_AT,PAUSED,CONTROL_REVISION,LAST_SUCCESS_AT,ACTIVE_RUN_ID FROM KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND DELETED=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC SET PAUSED=#{paused},CONTROL_REVISION=CONTROL_REVISION+1,REVISION=REVISION+1,LEASE_OWNER=NULL,LEASE_UNTIL=0,NEXT_POLL_AT=0 WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND CONTROL_REVISION=#{expected} AND DELETED=0
UPDATE KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC SET NEXT_POLL_AT=0 WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND PAUSED=0 AND DELETED=0
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ,ID,BODY_JSON FROM KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC_RUN WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND ID=#{id} AND DELETED=0
mapper.update: UPDATE KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC_RUN SET BODY_JSON=#{body} WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{row.tenantKey} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{row.sourceKey} AND ID=#{row.activeRunId} AND DELETED=0
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ,ID,BODY_JSON FROM KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC_RUN WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND DELETED=0 AND SEQ < #{before} ORDER BY SEQ DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SOURCE_REVISION,CONTENT_HASH,DOCUMENT_VERSION,DOCUMENT_ID,EXTERNAL_ID,SOURCE_DELETED FROM KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC_DOCUMENT WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND EXTERNAL_KEY=#{external} AND DELETED=0
mapper.update: UPDATE KNOWLEDGE_HTTP_SYNC_DOCUMENT SET SOURCE_REVISION=#{version},CONTENT_HASH=#{hash},DOCUMENT_VERSION=#{documentVersion},DOCUMENT_ID=#{documentId},EXTERNAL_ID=#{externalId},SOURCE_DELETED=#{sourceDeleted} WHERE TENANT_KEY=#{tenant} AND SOURCE_KEY=#{source} AND EXTERNAL_KEY=#{external} AND SOURCE_REVISION < #{version} AND DELETED=0
